#!/bin/bash
#
# Slurm job script for a LAMMPS simulation
#

# -- Directives --
#SBATCH --job-name=lammps_simulation
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=64
#SBATCH --output=lammps_output_%j.log

# --- Performance Optimization ---
# On a single hpc7g.6xlarge node with 64 cores, running 64 tasks means one task per core.
# Binding tasks to cores can improve performance by preventing task migration and improving cache utilization.
#SBATCH --cpu-bind=cores

# -- Application --
# Using srun is the standard way to launch parallel jobs in Slurm.
# The arguments to the lmp command are preserved from the original flux command.
srun lmp -v x 20 -v y 20 -v z 20 -in in.reaxff.hns
